questions.stem: In Theresa’s view, what is the present government doing?
questions.asr_text: In Teresa's view, what is the present government doing?
questions.answer_text: Reducing opportunities for state school pupils.

questions.stem: What is the problem in secondary schools now?
questions.asr_text: What is the problem in secondary schools now?
questions.answer_text: The government has lowered state pupils' expectations.

questions.stem: What can we learn from the interview?
questions.asr_text: What can we learn from the interview?
questions.answer_text: State system in secondary education needs improvement.

questions.stem: What contribution does Theresa think her party has made in education?
questions.asr_text: What contribution does Teresa think her party has made in education?
questions.answer_text: Getting more young people into universities.

questions.stem: What’s the man’s focus in this part of the interview?
questions.asr_text: What's the man's focus in this part of the interview?
questions.answer_text: The number of state school pupils going to elite universities.

questions.stem: In Theresa’s view, what is school freedom?
questions.asr_text: In Teresa's view, what is school freedom?
questions.answer_text: It means getting all the money and deciding how to spend it.

questions.stem: According to Theresa, who decides money for schools at the present?
questions.asr_text: According to Teresa, who decides money for schools at the present?
questions.answer_text: Local education authorities and the central government.

questions.stem: What is the role of the interviewer throughout the talk?
questions.asr_text: What is the role of the interviewer throughout the talk?

questions.stem: Why some state school pupils give up applying to leading universities?
questions.asr_text: Why some state school pupils give up applying to leading universities
questions.answer_text: Because they are misled by the government.

questions.stem: What do we learn about the money being spent on schools at the moment?
questions.asr_text: What do we learn about the money being spent on schools at the moment?
questions.answer_text: Some of the money goes to schools.
